name: bind-derived-props-and-stream
description: A blueprint manifest with no `mcpTools` and a contract carrying tool lineage in both places derivation reads: `propsSpec.properties[*].sourceTool` and `streamSpec[*].source.tool`. The resolver MUST derive bare `{tool}` entries (contracts carry no server identity), marked `derived`, in first-appearance order: props entries in declaration order, then stream channels in declaration order.
